benefits.name: Uber One 6-Month Free Trial
benefits.description: Six-month free trial of Uber One when signing up with Apple Card via Apple Pay.
benefits.terms: New or returning Uber One subscribers only (not valid for existing subscribers). Must sign up through the exclusive Apple Card offer link, using Apple Pay. Auto-renews at $9.99/month after the trial.

earningRates.terms: 3% Daily Cash at Apple and select merchants when paying with Apple Pay.
2% Daily Cash on all other Apple Pay purchases.
1% Daily Cash on purchases made with the physical titanium card or card number (not Apple Pay).
